selection.rule: state-diagram or state-diagram-v2 original whose body declares a standalone `--` divider line, with no in-body directive line and no classDef/class/style/cssClass statement
selection.exclusions: the four {dark,default,forest,neutral}-theme rows carry a leading %%{init}%% directive and belong to phase P2; the four user-styled-with-regions rows carry state styling and stay whole-source
selection.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 is measured per row.

P1-concurrent-regions.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review (fresh general-purpose agent, RFC 0048 State concurrent regions, 2026-11-22)
P1-concurrent-regions.note: Filled at phase closure: the frame = twin + footer evidence, the paired negative audit and the cross-region fail-closed gate.

counts.note: state_diagram/state_diagram_v2 are the phase-P1 per-family counts; phase_p1/phase_p2 are the authoritative phase totals and families_p2 holds the phase-P2 per-family counts
